Select: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Source: molecule_dictionary (parent), molecule_hierarchy, molecule_dictionary (child), compound_structures, compound_records, docs, activities, assays, target_dictionary. Join: parent molecule_dictionary to molecule_hierarchy on parent_molregno. molecule_hierarchy to child molecule_dictionary on molregno. child molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. child molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno. compound_records to docs on doc_id. compound_records to activities on record_id. activities to assays on assay_id. activities to target_dictionary on tid. Filter: parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1336'. target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL279'. activities.standard_type = 'IC50'. activities.standard_units = 'nM'. Sort: compound_chembl_id ASC, compound_key ASC, pubmed_id_or_doi ASC, assay_description ASC, standard_type ASC, standard_relation ASC, standard_value ASC, standard_units ASC, target_chembl_id ASC, target_name ASC, target_organism ASC. Limit: None.
